facts.business: Kesar Terminals & Infrastructure Limited operates liquid storage terminals at Kandla, Gujarat.

auditor.name: M/s. Chandabhoy & Jassoobhoy Chartered Accountants
auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Qualified opinion due to pending litigation with Deendayal Port Trust (DPT) regarding transfer/upfront fees and lease rent revision; no provision made for incremental liability. Emphasis of matter on impairment of investment and loans in DP World Multimodal Logistics Powerkheda Limited (former subsidiary), with Rs. 6,858.33 lakhs provided at 50% as of 31.03.2022 and remaining loss of Rs. 3,648.83 lakhs recognized as exceptional item in current year upon sale completion on 10.09.2025.

key_risks: Pending litigation with Deendayal Port Trust (DPT) over transfer/upfront fees and lease rent revision for leasehold lands at Kandla terminals
Uncertainty in final outcome of DPT litigation impacting profits, right-to-use lease assets, and lease liabilities
Impairment of investment and loans in former subsidiary DP World Multimodal Logistics Powerkheda Limited
